@attributes.sheet: Positioning - Kevin Surace - AI Leadership + Joy-Success

Item: CTOs, founders, CEOs, C-suite executives navigating AI transformation. Conference organizers evaluating AI keynote speakers.
Primary: CTOs and technical leaders, Founders/CEOs (Series A through enterprise). Secondary: Senior managers, entrepreneurs, aspiring leaders interested in Joy-Success framework.
Keynote speaking ($25K+ tier), The Joy-Success Cycle (book), Appvance (AI-powered software testing), Blog/thought leadership content
Bridge the gap between deep technical AI expertise and human-centered leadership. Show leaders how curiosity and joy drive sustainable success in an AI-transformed world.

Alternative.ProblemSummary: Surface-level trend analysis without builder credibility; readers can't distinguish between someone who reads about AI and someone who builds it
Alternative.DifferentiationSummary: Kevin invented the first AI-powered virtual assistant, holds 95 patents, and runs an AI company — he writes from the builder's workbench, not the press box

Alternative.ProblemSummary: Data-rich but personality-poor; no personal narrative, no vulnerability, no practical founder experience
Alternative.DifferentiationSummary: Kevin combines deep data with personal stories (invention, loss, joy), conversational authority, and actionable frameworks readers can use immediately

Alternative.ProblemSummary: Abstract motivation without substance; no grounding in science, business data, or real-world company building
Alternative.DifferentiationSummary: Joy-Success Cycle is grounded in neuroscience, positive psychology research, and Kevin's own experience building companies and navigating personal loss

UnfairAdvantage.Statement: No other AI thought leader combines: actually inventing foundational AI technology (the virtual assistant), 95 patents proving depth of innovation, a published framework for human performance (Joy-Success Cycle), and 20+ years of keynote speaking at the highest level ($25K+ fee tier).
UnfairAdvantage.OneSentence: Kevin is the AI thought leader who actually built AI — and who can tell you why curiosity and joy matter more than any tool.
